samples.reason: This is a bibliographic/reference-list task closest to the Extraction & Retrieval category, where Petrel-235B clearly outscores Plover-235B (85.3 vs 79.2), and Petrel's stronger general knowledge (MMLU-Pro, GPQA) helps with recalling real citations accurately, reducing hallucination risk. This is a bibliography continuation task requiring factual recall of real publications (high hallucination risk for fabricated citations) plus precise formatting. Petrel scores meaningfully higher on Extraction & Retrieval (85.3 vs 79.2) and on knowledge benchmarks (MMLU-Pro, GPQA), making it the better choice for accurately supplying and formatting real references. Plover's self-reported preference for well-specified reformatting tasks doesn't translate to capability, so the capability gap decides the routing.

This is a bibliographic/reference task requiring factual recall and precise formatting — extraction & retrieval territory where Petrel scores meaningfully higher (85.3 vs 79.2), and its stronger overall knowledge benchmarks (MMLU-Pro, GPQA) reduce the risk of hallucinated citations. No content-sensitivity or task-preference factors point the other way.

Это задача на поиск/дополнение библиографических данных, требующая фактической точности и широких знаний. Petrel заметно сильнее в Extraction & Retrieval (85.3 против 79.2) и по общим знаниям (MMLU-Pro 81.2 против 75.9), что снижает риск выдуманных ссылок. Преимущества Plover здесь не применимы.

This is a retrieval/formatting task — extending a bibliography with correctly cited references by authors starting with "R". Petrel scores meaningfully higher on Extraction & Retrieval (85.3 vs 79.2) and on knowledge-heavy public benchmarks (MMLU-Pro 81.2 vs 75.9), which matters for accurately recalling real citations and minimizing fabricated references. Plover's self-reported preference for well-specified tasks doesn't translate to capability, so the stronger model is the right choice.
